parsing_traps: Portfolio Statement (p122) carrying-value column lists only the 8 directly-held investment properties (Σ = S$5,573,016k = audited 'Investment properties, at valuation'). The 5 JV/associate properties (One Raffles Quay, MBFC Towers 1&2+Mall, MBFC Tower 3, 8 Chifley Square, David Malcolm Justice Centre) appear in that statement with NO carrying value — they are equity-accounted via the single 'Investments in associates and joint ventures' line (S$4,220,248k). Their appraised values are on p123 at Keppel REIT's interest.

p123 valuation table presents ALL properties at Keppel REIT's INTEREST (e.g. OFC at S$2,301,120k = 79.9%), totalling S$11,657,085k. The audited carrying values on p122 for OFC/T Tower/KR Ginza II are on a 100% basis. market_valuation for the 8 directly-held properties uses the Tier-C p122 carrying value (100% where carried at 100%); the 5 JV properties use the p123 KR-interest valuation.
8 Exhibition Street = 50% interest in the office building + 100% interest in the three adjacent retail units (one combined row).

MBFC card (p44) combines Towers 1,2,3 + Link Mall (1,460,852 sf NLA, S$112.3m NPI); the Portfolio Statement splits MBFC into two JV lines (Towers 1&2+Mall via BFC Development LLP at 1/3, and Tower 3 via Central Boulevard Development at 2/3), so per-tower NLA/NPI are not separable. Combined NLA/NPI assigned to neither tower row; NPI null on both JV MBFC rows.

reconciliation.npi_basis_note: Per-property net_property_income is disclosed on an ATTRIBUTABLE (Keppel REIT's interest) basis. Σ of all 14 properties' attributable NPI = S$381.3m, matching the disclosed 'Keppel REIT's attributable NPI for 2025 was $381.4 million' / 'Attributable NPI by Property' total (p64). This is NOT comparable to the consolidated Group NPI of S$215,905k (which consolidates OFC/T Tower/KR Ginza II at 100% and EXCLUDES equity-accounted JV property NPI). The gate's default comparator (Group NPI) therefore legitimately differs by basis — full_consolidation_partial_ownership + equity-accounted JVs.
